## 88fea6584461

**Reproduced defect — generated-domain rule crash.** Generator version `2.0.1`,
SHA-256 `2f748d6ac72b3f7ba0921ea77d31dfc1d9f0ae54237eb0eadead771eb7df9927`,
advertises `texture=no_divider`. With seed 0, sample index 0, medium difficulty,
that exact override returns a 3×9 grid with no color-8 divider, and
`self_check` returns `[]`. The input therefore belongs to the documented
generator domain and is accepted by its validator.

Applying canonical rule hash `2d4ec400d907` exits 1 with
`RacketBridgeError: in-range: contract violation; expected real?; given #f`.
There is no authoritative output. Full input, hashes, validator result, command,
and an illustrative fixed-center rival output are in
`checks/audit/88fea6584461/counterexample.json`; the supported Racket record is
`checks/audit/88fea6584461/racket.json`.

The independent defect-lint reproduction also fails and reports all three
advertised degenerate textures passing `self_check`, no `RULE_HASH`, dead
textures, and weak self-check power. Evidence:
`checks/audit/88fea6584461/defect-lint/checks/88fea6584461_after_defect_lint.log`.
No audit-target source was changed.
